---
title: "2026 Florida Republican Primary for Governor"
format: html
execute:
  echo: true
  message: false
  warning: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)

# Read all 67 county tab-separated files (which have no header row)
files <- list.files("data", pattern = "\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)

raw_gov_rep <- read_tsv(
  files,
  col_names = FALSE,
  quote = "",
  col_select = c(county = X2, office = X12, candidate = X15, party = X16, votes = X19),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  # Keep only Republican candidates in the Governor primary
  filter(office == "Governor", party == "REP") |>
  mutate(votes = as.numeric(votes))

# Sum total votes across all counties for each candidate
gov_rep <- raw_gov_rep |>
  summarize(total_votes = sum(votes, na.rm = TRUE), .by = candidate) |>
  mutate(pct = total_votes / sum(total_votes))

# Plot candidate vote totals with value annotations
ggplot(gov_rep, aes(x = total_votes, y = fct_reorder(candidate, total_votes))) +
  geom_col(fill = "firebrick") +
  # Add vote total and percentage labels to the right of each bar
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0(comma(total_votes), " (", percent(pct, accuracy = 0.1), ")")),
    hjust = -0.05,
    size = 3.3
  ) +
  # Call out the primary winner's margin
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 580000,
    y = 4,
    label = "Byron Donalds won 50 of 67 counties,\nnearly doubling runner-up Jay Collins",
    color = "firebrick4",
    fontface = "italic",
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = label_comma(),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.25))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "2026 Florida Republican Primary for Governor",
    subtitle = "Official precinct-level vote totals across all 67 counties",
    x = "Total Votes",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Source: Florida Department of State"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## County Heat Map

```{r}
# Calculate Byron Donalds's vote share in each county and match map_data names
county_shares <- raw_gov_rep |>
  summarize(votes = sum(votes, na.rm = TRUE), .by = c(county, candidate)) |>
  mutate(vote_share = votes / sum(votes), .by = county) |>
  filter(candidate == "Byron Donalds") |>
  mutate(
    subregion = tolower(county),
    subregion = case_match(
      subregion,
      "desoto" ~ "de soto",
      "st. johns" ~ "st johns",
      "st. lucie" ~ "st lucie",
      .default = subregion
    )
  )

# Join county election results with Florida county polygon coordinates
fl_map <- map_data("county", "florida") |>
  left_join(county_shares, by = "subregion")

# Plot a county heat map of vote share
ggplot(fl_map, aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group, fill = vote_share)) +
  geom_polygon(color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  coord_quickmap() +
  scale_fill_distiller(
    palette = "Reds",
    direction = 1,
    labels = label_percent(accuracy = 1),
    name = "Donalds\nVote Share"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Republican Primary Vote Share by County (2026)",
    subtitle = "Share of Republican gubernatorial primary votes cast for winner Byron Donalds",
    caption = "Source: Florida Department of State"
  ) +
  theme_void()
```
